YAYA Brand Identity Research - Key findings:
- Dutch lifestyle clothing brand since 1992, targets women with refined taste
- Color palette: Neutral, earthy tones (browns, whites, grays) with scarlet red accents
- Typography: Helvetica primary, Times New Roman for headings
- Design aesthetic: Minimalist, sophisticated, understated elegance
- Layout: Grid-based, asymmetrical images, generous white space
- Buttons: Rounded corners (3.75rem), uppercase text, minimal design
- Brand personality: Soft, feminine, comfortable yet refined, natural tones
- Key values: Balance between stylish and casual, timeless collections

YAYA Dashboard API Architecture Complete - Created comprehensive n8n workflow integration:

1. Workflow Execution API (/api/workflows/[id]/execute) - Triggers n8n workflows with validation
2. Status Polling API (/api/workflows/[id]/status/[executionId]) - Tracks execution progress and processes outputs
3. Feedback System API (/api/workflows/[id]/feedback) - Handles user feedback and triggers improvement workflows
4. Workflow Management API (/api/workflows) - Lists, creates, and manages workflow definitions

Key Features:
- Dynamic input validation based on workflow schemas
- Multi-format output processing (images, videos, text, files)
- Intelligent feedback categorization (content/style/format/quality)
- Automatic improvement workflow triggering
- Comprehensive workflow statistics and monitoring
- YAYA-branded UI with earth tones and elegant design
